challenges.resolution: recordExactly proves both directions of field equality. priorCoordinatesExact reconstructs the prior ordered record from each successor; applying this to successor equality contradicts any original distinction. leastRequiredIdentity and noExtraIdentityRule give the exact required-observation relation.
